title: Virtual Compute: cumulative outage credit cap fraction
content:
## Meaning — cumulative outage credit cap fraction

Virtual Compute cumulative outage credit cap fraction: Maximum cumulative outage credit fraction of the source charge net service subtotal; decimal.

## Tier values — cumulative outage credit cap fraction

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — cumulative outage credit cap fraction: 0.3.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — cumulative outage credit cap fraction: 0.3.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — cumulative outage credit cap fraction: 0.3.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — cumulative outage credit cap fraction: 0.3.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — cumulative outage credit cap fraction: 0.3.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — cumulative outage credit cap fraction: 0.3.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for cumulative outage credit cap fraction?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has cumulative outage credit cap fraction of 0.3.
